versions.changelog: 마케팅 카피로 설명 개선, 1개월 무료 체험 추가

OpenViking Pro v1.0.0 released!

- Introduces cloud-based Korean Context DB with up to 96% token cost reduction.
- Enables cloud sync, team sharing, and API Key-based access.
- Adds vector-based search, automatic synchronization, and dashboard analytics.
- Supports free and paid plans with usage limits and team options.
- Specializes in Korean: morphological search, business templates, and local time summarization.
